headline: Bank of America (BAC) Stock Could Stay Reasonable Despite Fresh AI Expansion News
summary: Bank of America stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet current valuation checks still point to a discount relative to an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model and to what earnings multiples imply. The share price has returned 111.1% over three years, which puts fresh focus on whether recent gains already reflect the underlying value of Bank of America. AI adoption across its operations and client services can support expectations for profitability,...
